lead.headline: McLaurin is questionable, and his only cover locks a day before he plays
lead.deck: Limited Thursday with the hamstring. If Saturday's report rules him out, Kamara has to go in before Sunday 11:00.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Terry McLaurin was limited in Washington's first practice of the week, on Thursday, with the hamstring, and ESPN has tagged him questionable. He plays Monday night at San Francisco. The only eligible player behind him is Alvin Kamara, limited all week with his back, whose game starts Sunday at 11:00 — after which he cannot be moved in. So the decision falls on Washington's Saturday report: out or doubtful means Coker to receiver and Kamara to the flex. Otherwise the lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.0 against Bok-aneers' 109.5, and ESPN gives you 59%.
